model: Series MS2 Magnesense II Differential Pressure Transmitter with BACnet (MS2-B)
applies_to: Dwyer Series MS2 Magnesense II differential pressure transmitters with BACnet MS/TP (ranges up to 25 in. w.c.).
summary: The MS2 Magnesense II is a differential pressure transmitter with BACnet MS/TP. It reports pressure in four units as analog inputs and calculated velocity and flow as analog values, using a writable K factor and duct area. Binary values select the default K factor, start zero and span calibration and restore factory values.
notes: Objects come from the manual object overview; access follows the object property tables in the appendices.
Velocity and flow (AV 1-4) use the K value (AV 5) and flow area (AV 6) only when BV 1 is 0; otherwise they are scaled 0-1.0 of full scale.

source.title: Series MS2 Magnesense II Differential Pressure Transmitter with BACnet Communication Protocol - Installation and Operating Instructions

integration.summary: Read the pressure in the unit you need (AI 1-4). For airflow, set BV 1 to 0, write the K value (AV 5) and duct area (AV 6), then read velocity or flow from AV 1-4.
setup: Left DIP switch SW1 sets the MS/TP MAC address (factory 127); the baud rate auto-detects after power-up or an address change.
Default device instance 607xxx (xxx = MAC); a device instance written over BACnet is kept even if the MAC changes.
Changes to Max Master and Max Info Frames need a power cycle.
DeviceCommunicationControl and ReinitializeDevice need the password "Dwyer".
gotchas: Span calibration (BV 3) only works within 5 minutes after a zero calibration (BV 2).
BV 1 ships as 1 (default K factor and area); velocity and flow are only real units after it is set to 0.
